paper_metadata.title: VLM: Task-agnostic Video-Language Model Pre-training for Video Understanding
paper_metadata.abstract: We present a simplified, task-agnostic multi-modal pre-training approach that can accept either video or text input, or both for a variety of end tasks. Existing pre-training are task-specific by adopting either a single cross-modal encoder that requires both modalities, limiting their use for retrieval-style end tasks or more complex multitask learning with two unimodal encoders, limiting early cross-modal fusion. We instead introduce new pretraining masking schemes that better mix across modalities (e.g. by forcing masks for text to predict the closest video embeddings) while also maintaining separability (e.g. unimodal predictions are sometimes required, without using all the input). Experimental results show strong performance across a wider range of tasks than any previous methods, often outperforming task-specific pre-training. Code is made available at https://github.com/pytorch/fairseq/tree/main/examples/MMPT.

extraction_data.innovation: Masked modality model (MMM): randomly masks an entire modality (video or text) for a portion of training examples, forcing the encoder to predict the masked modality using tokens from the other modality; single masked token loss: replaces separate video and text masked token losses with a unified loss to improve cross-modal fusion while maintaining modality separability.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Masked modality modeling, masked token prediction
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Text-video retrieval, video captioning, action step localization, video question answering
extraction_data.research_problem: Video-Language Model Pre-training for Video Understanding
extraction_data.application: text-video retrieval, video captioning, action step localization, video question answering
extraction_data.paper_title: VLM: Task-agnostic Video-Language Model Pre-training for Video Understanding
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Self-attention with task-specific masks; cross-modal mapping in some heads
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Task-agnostic pre-training on joint video-text data -> fine-tuning with task-specific attention masks
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Shared weights between video and text tokens; single masked language model
